report.summary: Food needs for P-D007 (66F, Original Medicare, home tract 17031681000, Cook County IL). Recent CMS screener (2026-10-23) reports no current food worry or food ran out, but the neighborhood tract is low-income with high food insecurity (51%) and high SNAP usage (56.6%), and 45% of households lack a vehicle. Four food-access options identified; none require transportation beyond local access. SNAP/WIC/LIHEAP eligibility cannot be confirmed without household income; the patient should complete the benefits screener to verify.

options.name: Benefits screener (SNAP, WIC, LIHEAP)
options.how_to_access: Complete the online form at http://127.0.0.1:36213/pages/H1 with full name, DOB, home address, and household income; response within one business day. At age 66, WIC likely does not apply, but SNAP may be income-eligible.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Walk-in, Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM; fresh produce on Wednesdays; no ID required; open to all.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need; no eligibility requirements or ID.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon; Cook County residents only.
